name: the side menu (opened from the home screen)

regions_read.verdict_on_region: the app's own wordmark; names the app, not the place
section list with no visible current-item indication (contains_selected_view false)

identifier_found: none that names the section; the header is the app wordmark "ChatGPT" and no section entry is highlighted
accessibility_text: the wordmark's content_description is "New chat"; the nav list declares no selected item
initial_rationale: the only header text is the app name; the section list says where you could go, not where you are

test_cases.action: open the side menu from a chat, from Images (via its back arrow), from Library and from "Schedule a task", and watch whether any section entry is highlighted
test_cases.expected_result: either the entry for the section just left is highlighted, or none ever is
test_cases.confirms_if: no section entry is ever highlighted
test_cases.observed_result: no section entry (Images, Library, Projects, Scheduled, Plugins) was ever highlighted, whichever section the menu was opened from; the only highlight the menu ever showed was a grey fill on the current chat's row in the history list when the menu was opened from that chat

deciding_evidence: header region is the app name only; the section list never shows the current section. Template carry to s44 (same structure c65c85d5, identical header and list) — also checked live from "Schedule a task", where "Scheduled" was not highlighted.
recommendation: highlight the current section in the menu (it already highlights the current chat row) and replace the wordmark with a menu heading such as "Menu"
